pages.title: Basic Operations
pages.text:
Right-click a doll to open its inventory — equip weapons, armor, and tools.

Baton: right-click a doll to select it (glowing enchantment marker), then right-click blocks to set a work area. Shift-right-click the doll to clear it.

Remote: right-click to open the control panel for managing all living dolls' modes and follow status at once.

Baton is crafted from 3 sticks. Remote is 2 iron ingots + 1 redstone.
